title: 第7章 俞月白这臭小子第8章 小玩意
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
昔小苑睁开眼睛，入眼的便是一张侧脸，皮肤超级好，毛孔都看不见。
昔小苑忍不住戳了一下那脸，而后沐梓丞带着一脸幽怨的眼神看着昔小苑，昔小苑发现……她好像抱着沐梓丞了，而且她刚刚还戳了一下他的脸。
我去……昔小苑猛然炸起，坐在里面往后退了退。捂着脸…她到底做了什么，竟然醒来是抱着沐梓丞的，而且她的脚还挎着他的腰。
我的天……虽然他很帅，但是这人这么腹黑这么坏，虽然长得样子是她的菜，但是她把他当做兄弟呀，竟然……
她竟然抱着梓丞兄弟睡了一晚，天哪嘞。
昔小苑说话都有些结巴了，说道：“那个…我…昨晚……对你…干了什么？！”
沐梓丞声音慢悠悠的传来，道：“被一个女流.氓给抱着睡了一夜，还会说梦话，踢被子！睡相极差。”
昔小苑不想面对自己了，虽然很尴尬，但是依旧保持微笑，虽然这微笑很勉强。
昔小苑尴尬又不是礼貌的微笑说道：“那个……咳咳！我…先去下去吃早点了，那个…小丞丞…”
沐梓丞听到她叫他小丞丞，一个冷眼过去。
昔小苑立马改口继而说道：“呃~那个梓丞兄，我先走了哈。”
然而沐梓丞表示不想理她，继续睡觉。
昔小苑说完动作麻利迅速至极跑下.床…………
昔小苑速度的洗漱完就下楼吃早餐了。大伙们也都起来了，吃完这早餐就该继续赶路了。
昔小苑刚坐下，便看到张文眼圈很重，一脸的憔悴。昔小苑看张文这个样子，心里想着：这孩子不会是吃了昨晚的菜起什么作用搞成这个样子吧。
昔小苑一脸关心又有些好奇的说道：“你怎么了？脸色憔悴成这样。”
张文一脸的生无可恋，喝着茶水润润喉的说道：“在下也不知道呀，昨夜跑茅厕好几趟，拉了一晚上的肚子。”
哎哟我去，还真在菜里下料了，幸好她没吃，怕是下了巴豆吧？看着张文那虚脱的样子………
让她想到沐梓丞那腹黑样，莫名的打了个冷颤，这丫的小丞丞可真腹黑，她都不敢招惹他了，哪天给她来点猛.料让她生不如死。
昔小苑想着想着就觉得身上有些发冷，凉飕飕的。然而沐梓丞已经睡醒咯，从昔小苑后面蹦出来，然后坐在旁边。

他好像有起床气似的，而且跟没睡醒一样，虽然冷着个脸，但是看着他那白白嫩.嫩的皮肤，还有他那绝世容颜的脸……
哎哟喂，看着他那睡眼朦胧的样子，为啥她会觉得他有点可爱。
昔小苑看着张文一脸的同情，还拍了拍张文的肩膀说道：“可怜的孩子。”
张文看丞相一脸的同情看着他，还说可怜的孩子？？？他怎么感觉内心跟吃了屎一样的难受呢？！而且孩子？貌似他比丞相大吧……
张文内心五谷杂陈的说道：“丞相…你…”
张文已经无言以对了，不知该用什么心情话语形容自己，而且丞相这话他没法接。
昔小苑一脸慈祥的微笑说道：“快吃吧，一会好上路。”
张文有些哭笑不得，有些想哭又有些笑，上路……怎么丞相这话那么让人觉得……堵呢。
“女神…”有人高喊道。
昔小苑看去，俞月白在木楼梯那看着她喊，而且一脸的兴奋，笑的一口白牙都出来了。
俞～月～白…这名字跟他还挺配的，眼睛笑的跟个月亮似得弯弯的，还有他那一口白牙，白的发亮。
他是不是可以做个什么牙膏代言人了？！
俞月白跑下来，坐在昔小苑的旁边，然而他做的那个位置沐梓丞正在坐着。
俞月白一坐下，感觉这里凉飕飕的，跟有股阴风一样似的……
俞月白摸摸自己的手臂，今天不是冬至呀。
昔小苑看着俞月白坐在那里，而且她看着他们两个人的身影她就觉得眼睛不够用了。
哎哟喂…俞月白是在作死吗。
昔小苑对俞月白说道：“你换个地方坐吧。”
content_en:
Xi Xiaoyuan opened her eyes, and what caught her eyes was a profile face with super good skin and no pores could be seen.
Xi Xiaoyuan couldn't help but poke the face, and then Mu Zicheng looked at Xi Xiaoyuan with a look of resentment. Xi Xiaoyuan found... She seemed to be hugging Mu Zicheng, and she just poked him in the face.
I'll go...Xi Xiaoyuan exploded suddenly, sat in it and stepped back. Covering her face... What on earth had she done to wake up holding Mu Zicheng, and her feet were still hanging around his waist.
Oh my god... Even though he is handsome, he is so sinister and evil. Even though he looks like her, she regards him as her brother, but...
She actually slept with brother Zi Cheng for one night, oh my god.
Xi Xiaoyuan stuttered a little when he spoke, and said: "Well... what... I... did... to you... last night?!"
Mu Zicheng's voice came slowly, and he said: "I was held by a female gangster and slept all night. She talked in her sleep and kicked the quilt! She was in a very bad state of sleep."
Xi Xiaoyuan didn't want to face herself anymore. Although she was embarrassed, she still kept smiling, although the smile was very forced.
Xi Xiaoyuan smiled awkwardly and said with an impolite smile: "Um...ahem! I...go down to have breakfast first, um...little Chengcheng..."
When Mu Zicheng heard her calling him Xiao Chengcheng, he gave her a cold look.
Xi Xiaoyuan immediately changed his mind and said, "Uh~ Brother Zicheng, I'll leave first."
However, Mu Zicheng said he didn't want to pay attention to her and continued to sleep.
After Xi Xiaoyuan finished speaking, she ran out of bed quickly and swiftly...
Xi Xiaoyuan quickly washed up and went downstairs to have breakfast. Everyone has also gotten up, and after finishing this breakfast, it is time to continue on the road.
As soon as Xi Xiaoyuan sat down, she saw Zhang Wen had heavy circles under his eyes and a haggard look on his face. Seeing Zhang Wen like this, Xi Xiaoyuan thought to herself: Could it be that the child ate last night's food and became like this?
Xi Xiaoyuan said with concern and curiosity: "What's wrong with you? You look so haggard."
Zhang Wen had a look of despair on his face. He drank some tea to moisten his throat and said, "I don't know, but I ran to the toilet several times last night and had diarrhea all night long."
Oh my gosh, I really put some ingredients into the dish. Fortunately, she didn't eat it. Is she probably adding some croton? Looking at Zhang Wen's exhausted look...
She shuddered inexplicably when she thought of Mu Zicheng's evil demeanor. This little Cheng Cheng was so evil that she didn't even dare to provoke him. If he gave her something violent one day, her life would be worse than death.
Xi Xiaoyuan felt a little chilly as she thought about it. However, Mu Zicheng had already woken up, jumped out from behind Xi Xiaoyuan, and sat next to him.
He seemed to be tired of waking up, and it was as if he had not woken up. Although his face was cold, looking at his fair and tender skin and his peerless face...
Ouch, looking at his sleepy look, why does she think he's a little cute?
Xi Xiaoyuan looked at the sympathy on Zhang Wen's face, patted Zhang Wen's shoulder and said, "Poor child."
Zhang Wen saw the prime minister looking at him with sympathy, and he said he was a poor child? ? ? Why does he feel as uncomfortable as eating shit? ! And children? It seems that he is older than the Prime Minister...
Zhang Wen said with mixed feelings in his heart: "Prime Minister...you..."
Zhang Wen was speechless. He didn't know what words to use to describe his mood, and he couldn't accept the Prime Minister's words.
Xi Xiaoyuan said with a kind smile: "Eat quickly, you will be on your way soon."
Zhang Wen felt a little dumbfounded, wanted to cry but also laughed a little, and set out on the road...why did the Prime Minister's words make people feel...congested.
"Goddess..." someone shouted.
Xi Xiaoyuan looked over and saw Yu Yuebai shouting at her from the wooden staircase, with an excited face and a smile that made his white teeth appear.
Yu～Yue～Bai...this name suits him quite well. His smiling eyes are as crooked as the moon, and his smile isThe teeth are white and shiny.
Can he be a toothpaste spokesperson? !
Yu Yuebai ran down and sat next to Xi Xiaoyuan, but Mu Zicheng was sitting where he was.
As soon as Yu Yuebai sat down, he felt that it was cool here, as if there was a dark wind...
Yu Yuebai touched his arm, today is not the winter solstice.
Xi Xiaoyuan looked at Yu Yuebai sitting there, and when she looked at the two of them, she felt that her eyes were not full.
Ouch... Is Yu Yuebai seeking death?
Xi Xiaoyuan said to Yu Yuebai, "Sit somewhere else."
